changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate task entries and normalized to standard task naming. Simplified output descriptions to be more concise.
Consolidated metric variants to base forms (e.g., BLEU-2/BLEU-4 → BLEU) and removed redundant entries that were already covered by the base metric names.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. GPT-3.5-turbo was used only as a baseline generation model, not for evaluation.
No human evaluation was mentioned in the paper - only automatic metrics were used for evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on cross-modal integration in biology, specifically evaluating molecule captioning and text-based molecule generation tasks. All evaluations are conducted using automatic metrics without human or LLM-as-judge assessment. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some duplicate entries that needed consolidation.
